## Checklist
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Modules stay read-only; root does not write where the user can, or run user-writable code
- [ ] No existing flag wording changed (or the CHANGELOG says so)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `Unreleased`
- [ ] No scan reports, real malware or real secrets in the diff
